race.comment: ANCHOR DOWN (5) hasn't made an impression since resuming despite market confidence. Last start could only manage eighth over 1400m at Jerilderie but should be at peak fitness now after two runs back. BANNERTON (1) has not appeared since he finished ninth over 2000m at Stawell on January 4. Rates highly and makes plenty of appeal at a track he has won at before. MUTSUHITO (4) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten 2.5 lengths when seventh in a 1412m contest at Echuca three weeks ago. Best figures measure up nicely so gets a big chance to return to form. SHASAM (10) turned things around last start and scored by 5 lengths over 1550m at Pooncarie. Suitably placed so anticipating another big run.
